newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela CVG plans $320 mln share issue in Q1 97.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela CVG plans $320 mln share issue in Q1 97.

text.p: Venezuelans will be able to buy shares in the Corporacion Venezolana de Guayana (CVG) industrial complex when it is partly privatised in early 1997, CVG President Elias Nadim Ynaty said.
"The CVG plans to offer Venezuelans some ten percent of the companies we will be privatising," Ynaty told reporters, adding that another ten percent would be offered to workers.
Venezuela is expected to raise $3.2 billion when it sells its steel and aluminium companies next year.
A current offering of 50 million CANTV shares is expected to raise upwards of $200 million. But a ten percent CVG share issue would further boost the Caracas bolsa's current weak capitalisation.
